reflections.adjustment: Lead with a defensive core that can safely set Trick Room (e.g., Sinistcha with a Fake Out or redirection partner) or bring a Steel-type to resist the opponent's Ghost/Flying attacks, preserving Charizard for late-game cleanup after speed control is reversed.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's Noivern carries Focus Sash, Tailwind, and Frisk; it often leads and threatens with Hurricane. Gengar-Mega is a fast special sweeper with Dazzling Gleam for spread damage. Incineroar uses Fake Out and Parting Shot to pivot. Opponent can also field Trick Room mode with Hatterene (Mental Herb, Magic Bounce) and Kingambit (Black Glasses, Defiant). Our sun mode is vulnerable to fast Flying and Ghost types; future games should incorporate a Steel-type or Wide Guard support, or prioritize Trick Room to neutralize their speed advantage.
